best_idea: A kill or theft becomes one shared record whose memory length depends on its kind and whose witnesses are the loaded actors inside a radius, so news spreads by who was there and fades by kind rather than by a global timer.
decision_why: Keep kind-based memory, radius witness delivery with presence gating, the once-read known set with a 5-minute response window and the site rumour path; index reports by zone chunk, cap them per zone and keep speech server-side, because the donor pushes one id into every inbox and has no report cap.
acceptance: A server test kills an enemy at a fixed point with a civilised NPC 20 units away and another 40 units away; the first speaks the death phrase to the killer within 300 in-game seconds and the second does not; a death without a killer is pruned after 5 days and a murder after 15 days.
